Arm 3 passed and PR #364 is ready for review.

**Arm 3 verdict: PASS, 1,253 of 1,253 checks.** I judged it from the two finished result dirs with the registered prediction, since no `[job.arms]` comment or verdict file had been written. Both scores files have no unreadable rows, neither run log has UtilAcceptVsock, and the partial-coverage floor is the known Depth_buffer and ZPass one in both arms.

The five bands all landed on the values arms 1 and 2 read:

| capture (Cn and Cy) | A | B | band |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| z24 FZn Mffffff_ZB | 144,566 | 47,935 | 47,935 .. 53,852 |
| z24 FZn Mc00000_ZB | 4,834 | 989 | 989 .. 1,037 |
| z24 FZn M800001_ZB | 2,868 | 520 | 520 .. 568 |
| z24 FZn M400002_ZB | 1,506 | 113 | 113 .. 145 |
| z16 FZn M00ffff_ZB | 2,840 | 424 | 424 .. 456 |

- **#275 Swap** went from 165,447 px to 0 on all three arms. The F24 gate held (all 20 z24 FZy rows stay at 24), and the W-buffer, Depth_buffer, Surface_format and all 32 Blend_surface guards held, including the two captures arm 3 left unguarded.
- **The one worse capture** is the unguarded Stencil_ZERO family (0 to 40,000), which moves between runs of one apk and is not a leg.

**What I did for the definition of done:**
- Wrote the arm 3 reading and the reason attempt 4's first session ended (a `waiting:` on an outside verdict) into `docs/lanes/zrtz272/NOTES.md`, committed and pushed as head 37e68c70b1.
- Preflight passes with `--allow-tracker`. The PR body's Files line matches the branch diffstat. A test merge of origin/master is clean and the PR reads MERGEABLE.
- Updated the PR body over REST with the verdict and #275's result, read it back to confirm, posted the reading as a lane comment, and ran `gh pr ready 364`.

**One thing outside my control:** the PR still carries arm 2's `regressed` label because the arms job has not yet judged arm 3's pair on disk. Arm 3 is the later registration on the same issue and supersedes arm 2 when the job judges it. CI on the new head is pending, with the check job already green.
